entry.title: Gonbad-e Qabus
entry.note: Exact Q606763 OSM footprint supplies center; nomination pp. 66-67 explicitly identifies east entrance, mapped to local +Z. Circular OSM polygon cannot resolve finer door azimuth. East-facing is a cardinal approximation; actual azimuth needs a georeferenced entrance survey. Sample terrain must include the mound summit, or the tower will be too low. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
